title: The GitHub profile somebody opens, and the one they close

videos.script: If your CV works, somebody clicks the GitHub link. They will give it about three clicks. {{click}} The first lands on your profile. The second opens one repository. The third opens the README, or one file. If any of those is empty, confusing or somebody else's tutorial, the tab closes. {{three}} Most profiles fail at the first click, because they show forty repositories of equal weight and none of them says what it is. {{fail}} This lesson walks the three clicks, decides what each one should find, and deals with the green squares people worry about far more than reviewers do.
